title: When Venus goes retrograde.
old_caption:
Suddenly thinking about every ex at once?
Venus retrograde makes old flames look brighter. That is nostalgia, not a sign.

title: Texas first. Then where?
old_caption:
Texas first. Then where should the stars go?
Houston started it, and every city is in the running. Tell us where to light up next.

title: Retro has amnesia.
old_caption: Ever relearn the same lesson twice? Retro forgot its apology and started drafting to exes again. Write down what you learned, so future you remembers when it counts.

title: The black hole.
old_caption:
Every unsent "i love you" and "i'm sorry" has to go somewhere. In this episode, the stars find out what happens when they finally say them out loud.
If it matters, say it while you can.

title: The Sun and the Moon have a secret.
old_caption:
The Sun and the Moon only see each other during rare eclipses. In this episode, they wonder what it would mean to stop waiting.
Love grows with steady time together. Put it on the calendar.

title: Star-crossed.
old_caption:
The season finale: Leo asks again, Aquarius answers "yes, slowly," and everyone gets an ending of their own.
The best love stories aren't rushed. They're chosen, every single day.

title: The proposal… interrupted.
old_caption: A proposal, an objection, and a very clear ruling: nobody gets a vote on a couple except the two people in it. Opinions are fine. Your relationship is still your call.

title: The ex who got demoted.
old_caption: An ex showing up to say you still belong to them? Your past can be part of your story without running your choices. Closure is yours to give yourself.

title: Who is Ophiuchus?
old_caption:
The Sun's path does cross Ophiuchus, but the zodiac splits it into twelve signs. Ophiuchus isn't a sign, and it just wanted to belong.
You don't need a title to be worth loving. Everyone deserves a seat.

title: Ophiuchus slides into Aquarius's DMs.
old_caption:
Ophiuchus sends hearts and a playlist. Aquarius answers kindly and clearly: taken, for real. No drama, nobody embarrassed.
A clear no is a kindness, to them and to the person you're with.
